issues.description: PersonService.getAllPersons is inconsistent between template/problem statement and solution: the exercise requires (and the template defines) `List<Person> getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions sortingOptions)` to support sorting (Part 3), and the solution’s PersonResource calls `personService.getAllPersons(new PersonSortingOptions(...))`. However, the solution’s PersonService only defines a no-argument `getAllPersons()` method, so the solution would not compile against its own PersonResource and contradicts the specified API.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution repository to match the required API: implement `List<Person> getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions sortingOptions)` in `src/server/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java` (including sorting by sortField/sortingOrder), and remove or rename the no-arg `getAllPersons()` to avoid signature conflicts. Keep PersonResource calling the parameterized method.
